description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing toolbar state in a React application, including popup management, toolbar positioning, font settings, and mobile responsiveness.

classes.name: PopupRef
classes.description: Represents a popup's reference with id, group, pinned status, and optional parent.

classes.name: ToolbarState
classes.description: Interface defining the state structure for the toolbar, including options, popups, and UI settings.

methods.name: useToolbarLocation
methods.description: Hook to access the current toolbar location ('top' or 'bottom').

methods.name: useIsMobile
methods.description: Hook to determine if the device is mobile.

methods.name: usePopupManager
methods.description: Hook to manage popup open/close, toggle, and pinned state within the toolbar.
